notes.healthCheck: No healthcheck key in the frontend service block (docker-compose.yml:250-308). Absence reported; library default, not in these files. Restart policy is unless-stopped (docker-compose.yml:262).
notes.telemetryServerSide: Node SDK started with --require ./Instrumentation.js (src/frontend/package.json:8). OTLPTraceExporter() and OTLPMetricExporter() are constructed without an explicit URL (src/frontend/utils/telemetry/Instrumentation.js:16, :26); endpoint comes from OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT (.env:32, passed through at docker-compose.yml:275). Metric reader has no exportIntervalMillis (Instrumentation.js:25-27); span batch delay and metric export interval are library defaults, not in these files. No log exporter is configured in these files. Service name OTEL_SERVICE_NAME=frontend (docker-compose.yml:278).
notes.telemetryBrowser: Browser traces use BatchSpanProcessor with scheduledDelayMillis: 500 (src/frontend/utils/telemetry/FrontendTracer.ts:39) to PUBLIC_OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_ENDPOINT = http://localhost:8080/otlp-http/v1/traces (.env:33). Not a server-side callee and not resolved further in these files.
notes.candidatePostures: modules/otel-demo/deployment/compose.candidate-postures.yml:66-73 sets OTEL_SDK_DISABLED, OTEL_TRACES_EXPORTER and OTEL_METRICS_EXPORTER for frontend from variables whose values are not in these files.
notes.rpcTransport: All seven RPC gateways use gRPC (@grpc/grpc-js) with ChannelCredentials.createInsecure() (line 9 of each gateway file). Callee addresses come from the *_SERVICE_ADDR variables in .env.

replicas.note: No replicas or scale key in the frontend service block (docker-compose.yml:250-308); its deploy block (:258-261) sets resources only. Compose default of one container, library default, not in these files.

exportsTelemetryTo.note: OTLP gRPC to otelcol:4317: OTEL_COLLECTOR_HOST=otelcol (.env:27), OTEL_COLLECTOR_PORT_GRPC=4317 (.env:28). Passed into the frontend container at docker-compose.yml:275. Used by OTLP exporters with no explicit URL at src/frontend/utils/telemetry/Instrumentation.js:16.
